content.thinking:
Even the smallest (100 requests) case took >180s?? That can't be right... unless `build()` is slow: `listed = ['r%05d' % rnd.randrange(nreq) for _ in range(per)]` with per = pairs//noff. For nreq=100,noff=200,pairs=1000 → per=5 ✓ fast. Hmm, but `forest(4096, 32)` is called with n=4096 always! And inside forest: `candidates = [j for j in range(i) if depths[j] < depth]` → O(n²) = 16M operations → slow (~10s). And validate(job) with 4096-node forests → path checks 4096×32 = 131k ✓ fast.

So the test generator itself is slow. Also note the build() creates 4096 quota nodes always. That's part of the cost. Let me time each step separately.

Let me rerun with timing per phase and a smaller quota forest for the scale test.
